title: Port import queue serialization and listener/promise behavior
scope: Complete ImportQueue pending/busy, ordered jobs, completion failure recovery and live listener identity/order over owned standard Rust futures. Runtime task driving and host abandonment remain explicit integration boundaries.
acceptance: Full pinned original class executes controlled job/listener traces before Rust. Compare pending/busy, all jobs/results and callback order, including listener errors and reentrant registration/enqueue.
Native bounded metadata/opaque error ownership and Wasm checks; no dependencies or second mutable business store.
open_items: Native/Wasm executor and concrete restore/import integration remain required.
Abandoned Rust futures are host failures, not a source cancellation feature; engine termination policy remains required.
Typed callback errors represent source exceptions; arbitrary Rust panic/OOM isolation is not exhaustive.
